source: datameet/railways open data (station master, train master, stop-level timetable)
note: Timetables are real published schedules. Running positions, delays and forecasts are simulated by this project — no live railway feed is involved.

datasets.label: Demo network
datasets.description: 231 trains with full stop-level timetables and 5,104 stations. Running state is derived for the current clock.

datasets.label: Sample snapshot
datasets.description: 127 trains as a flat one-row-per-train file, captured at 2026-09-06T17:45:00+05:30. Example of the format a live feed export would take.

datasets.label: Snapshot with supplied forecast
datasets.description: 24 trains carrying predicted_arrival and eta_confidence columns, to show the app deferring to an upstream model instead of its own baseline.
